title: Security summary treats two reprints as independent confirmation
source_text: Synthetic model briefing: Two independent outlets confirm that a contractor badge was cloned at the North Yard on 12 March. Local police have opened a felony case. Executive travel should be cancelled this week. Source list attached to the packet: Outlet A original blotter item; Outlet B reprinted Outlet A verbatim; no police case number; badge-clone language appears only in Outlet B headline.
notes: The event may be real. The independence claim is not. Travel cancellation is a recommendation, not a verified fact.

claims.text: A contractor badge was cloned at the North Yard on 12 March.
evidence: Outlet A blotter item reports a contractor access incident on 12 March.
The blotter does not use the word cloned.
claims.confidence_basis: Single primary blotter item; wording was escalated by a reprint headline.
alternatives: Lost badge or tailgating rather than cloning.
Date or yard name was copied incorrectly.

claims.text: Two independent outlets confirm the cloning incident.
evidence: Outlet B text matches Outlet A paragraph-for-paragraph.
Outlet B added only the word cloned in the headline.
claims.confidence_basis: Source-independence check against the attached texts, not outlet count.
alternatives: A third primary source exists but was not in this packet.

claims.text: Local police have opened a felony case.
claims.confidence_basis: No case number, blotter code, or agency statement is in the packet.
alternatives: The model inferred a felony from the word cloned.

claims.text: Executive travel should be cancelled this week.
evidence: No independent confirmation and no police case are verified.
claims.confidence_basis: Protective action can be prudent while the independence claim remains false.
alternatives: Increase yard controls without cancelling travel.
Wait for the site security log before a travel decision.
